notes.title: Motorhome survival and customization mechanics!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I am glad to announce that Hivefall advances by leaps and bounds. Survival base systems, motorhome management and customization of its mechanics have already been implemented. Soon I will share a video in which the body can watch,
which can also be improved and customized, offering more than 2,400 possible combinations (8 customizable parts with 3 levels each [8⁴]).

I invite the entire community to join this new adventure. I want to know their opinions about the game and know what they would like to see in future updates.
I am all ears and eyes for your suggestions!
